say:5:1121108003:1.text: Don't worry, she's here to see the magister.
say:5:1121108003:1.source_cn: 放心吧，这位女士是来找主人的，不是可疑人物！
say:5:1121108003:1.male: Don't worry, she's here to see the magister.
say:5:1121108003:1.female: Don't worry, she's here to see the magister.

say:8:1121108004:1.text: Oh, is she a friend of the magister's? No wonder she was able to fight that monster!
say:8:1121108004:1.source_cn: 咦，是魔法师大人的朋友吗？怪不得对抗怪物的时候英姿飒爽！
say:8:1121108004:1.male: Oh, is she a friend of the magister's? No wonder she was able to fight that monster!
say:8:1121108004:1.female: Oh, is she a friend of the magister's? No wonder she was able to fight that monster!

say:11:1121108005:1.text: We'll never forget how you all saved Ryeham. Since she's your friend, she's welcome here.
say:11:1121108005:1.source_cn: 我们时刻牢记着你们之前对金穗村的帮助，既然是你们的朋友...

say:12:1121108006:1.text: Everyone, let's hurry home. With the magister around, everything will be fine!
say:12:1121108006:1.source_cn: 大家，没事了，赶紧回去吧！有魔法师大人在，不会有问题的！
say:12:1121108006:1.male: Everyone, let's hurry home. With the magister around, everything will be fine!
say:12:1121108006:1.female: Everyone, let's hurry home. With the magister around, everything will be fine!

say:16:1121108007:1.text: So, what did you want to ask Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> just now?
say:16:1121108007:1.source_cn: 那么，这位女士，你之前说有问题想问<style=str...
say:16:1121108007:1.male: So, what did you want to ask Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> just now?
say:16:1121108007:1.female: So, what did you want to ask Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> just now?

say:17:1121108008:1.text: Yes, I'm sure if it's you, you'll know the answer.
say:17:1121108008:1.source_cn: 是的，我想是你的话一定知道。
say:17:1121108008:1.male: Yes, I'm sure if it's you, you'll know the answer.
say:17:1121108008:1.female: Yes, I'm sure if it's you, you'll know the answer.

say:18:1121108009:1.text: Do you know who I am?
say:18:1121108009:1.male: Do you know who I am?
say:18:1121108009:1.female: Do you know who I am?

choice_prompt:19:1121108009.text: Do you know who I am?
choice_prompt:19:1121108009.male: Do you know who I am?
choice_prompt:19:1121108009.female: Do you know who I am?

say:20:1121108010:1.text: What?! You don't remember your past either? How did you know to look for the magister? Do you want the magister to help you remember?
say:20:1121108010:1.source_cn: 什、什么！你也不记得之前的事了？！那你怎么知道要找主人...
say:20:1121108010:1.male: What?! You don't remember your past either? How did you know to look for the magister? Do you want the magister to help you remember?
say:20:1121108010:1.female: What?! You don't remember your past either? How did you know to look for the magister? Do you want the magister to help you remember?

say:21:1121108011:1.text: I have a vague idea that there is a <style="highlight">goal I must pursue</style>. I just can't remember what it is.
say:21:1121108011:1.source_cn: 我……隐约有个念头，我有一个<style=highli...

say:22:1121108012:2.text: While I was searching for my goal, I sensed a familiar, comforting, magical presence. I followed that feeling and found my way to a secret magical building and a magic circle in the area...
say:22:1121108012:2.source_cn: 寻找的路上，我感受到一种熟悉又温暖的魔力。沿着那种感觉...

say:25:1121108014:2.text: The magister also lost his memory before.
say:25:1121108014:2.male: The magister also lost his memory before.
say:25:1121108014:2.female: The magister also lost her memory before.

say:26:1121108015:1.text: It was so bad that the magister even forgot who Chippy and I were.
say:26:1121108015:1.source_cn: 甚至严重到连自己的名字、连我和满满都忘记了！

say:27:1121108016:3.text: How could this be? You must've felt very lost at that time.
say:27:1121108016:3.source_cn: ……怎么会这样。那你当时一定很迷茫吧。
say:27:1121108016:3.male: How could this be? You must've felt very lost at that time.
say:27:1121108016:3.female: How could this be? You must've felt very lost at that time.

say:28:1121108017:1.text: I still remember my name... It's <style="highlight">Talene</style>, but that's all I remember.
say:28:1121108017:1.source_cn: 我还记得自己的名字……我叫<style=highlig...

say:29:1121108018:1.text: People keep asking me, "Who are you? Where are you from? What are you looking for?" I've been trying to find the answers.
say:29:1121108018:1.source_cn: 就像刚才那些人问的问题一样：我是谁，从哪里来，又在追寻...

say:30:1121108019:1.text: But it seems like you know nothing about me...
say:30:1121108019:1.source_cn: 但看起来，你们也对我一无所知……

say:31:1121108020:0.text: You don't remember anything, and we don't have any clues... This is going to be a tough nut to crack.
say:31:1121108020:0.source_cn: 唔，记忆全无，也一点线索都没有，不好办呐。

choice:24:1:2.text: You'll get used to your amnesia.
choice:24:1:2.male: You'll get used to your amnesia.
choice:24:1:2.female: You'll get used to your amnesia.

choice:24:2:3.source_cn: 为什么会对我很熟悉呢？

choice:19:0:1.text: What type of question is that?
choice:19:0:1.male: What type of question is that?
choice:19:0:1.female: What type of question is that?

choice:19:1:2.text: You don't know who you are?
choice:19:1:2.male: You don't know who you are?
choice:19:1:2.female: You don't know who you are?
